title: MemorySpace
description: Provider-managed memory space: single-writer authority binding, freeze status, and the receipt-drain counter (MEM-R001, MEM-R023).

authority_host_id.description: host_id of the single authoritative provider (MEM-R001).
authority_host_id.title: AuthorityHostId

authority_generation.description: Increments on each cutover (import activation into the space) and on each operator re-open after rollback. Client bindings pin (authority_host_id, authority_generation).

status.description: A frozen space admits only the maintenance allowlist (§8.2).
status.title: Status

pending_receipts.description: Computed at read time: count of receipts with status pending. The drain barrier (MEM-R023).

revision.description: Per-object optimistic-concurrency counter (MEM-R007). Bumped by freeze/unfreeze and cutover.
